metadata.name: percaya
metadata.description: Pooled crypto calls and Seeker hardware-anchored reputation on Solana

instructions.name: verify_seeker_genesis
docs: Binds a 1-per-device Token-2022 NonTransferable Seeker Genesis NFT to this caller.
`GenesisRegistry` is initialized with `init` so the same hardware token can never
initialize a second fresh caller record to reset negative returns or slashes.
